notes: With Critzer's g.f. as the definition (bivariate series G in (Polynomial Q)[[z]], G * E(-z) = E((u-1)z)), all three claims proved in Lean (A117414_main): row sums = (2n)! [x^2n] sec, T(n,1) = n (2n-1)! [x^(2n-1)] tan, T(n,2) = (2n)! [x^2n] (x tan x - x^2)/8, with sec = cos^-1 and tan = sin sec as formal power series over Q (Mathlib PowerSeries.cos/sin). Proof via the ring map z -> x^2/2 (expand 2 . rescale 1/2) sending E(-z) to cos. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.
